description: Use this skill when the owner wants a ready-to-paste research prompt for a "deep research" AI tool (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek, or similar) to investigate a topic before writing content. Invoke when the user says "give me a research prompt for X", "write me a deep research prompt", "I need to research this before drafting", or "generate a prompt I can run in ChatGPT/Perplexity for research". This produces only the prompt text — it does not run research itself, call any external tool, or save results anywhere.
